businessObjective: Enable Human Resources Administrator to securely log in to the OrangeHRM portal using my administrator credentials so that I can manage personnel records in order to I can manage personnel records.
preconditions: Target application OrangeHRM is reachable in the test environment
User is in an authorized initial state on web

mainFlow.action: Navigate to OrangeHRM Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access interface on web

mainFlow.action: Enter required input data according to standard positive criteria
mainFlow.expected: Inputs are populated and validated without errors

mainFlow.action: Submit or confirm the primary action
